caption: The drawing depicts a single, rectangular chest or box with a curved lid, situated on a plain, off-white background. The chest features a handle mounted on top of the domed lid, which is oval-shaped and detailed with a floral or beaded pattern. The chest is decorated with painted designs: yellow, leafy patterns run along the edges of the lid and the side panels, while the central front and side surfaces display a floral motif with orange and red circular shapes resembling flowers or fruits, and green leaves. The main color of the chest is a dark, mottled blue or black with visible texture, possibly indicating a metallic or lacquered finish. The lock in the center of the front panel is rendered in muted gray tones. The overall composition is centered, and the box is oriented at an angle, showing both the front and right side. There is a small signature in black ink near the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Tin Oblong Box
